name: Subscriber
signature: struct Subscriber<N = format::DefaultFields, E = format::Format<format::Full>, F = filter::LevelFilter, W = fn() -> io::Stdout>
docs:
A `Subscriber` that logs formatted representations of `tracing` events.

This consists of an inner `Formatter` wrapped in a layer that performs filtering.
availability: Observed in the hosted capture; reachability is separate from raw visibility. Consumer dependency/features/target must be checked independently.

name: DEFAULT_MAX_LEVEL
docs:
The maximum [verbosity level] that is enabled by a `Subscriber` by
default.

This can be overridden with the [`SubscriberBuilder::with_max_level`] method.

[verbosity level]: tracing_core::Level
[`SubscriberBuilder::with_max_level`]: SubscriberBuilder::with_max_level
